name: LexiShift Rulegen Benchmark Cases (en-ja)
description: Pair-local development benchmark cases for en-ja. Refresh the compatibility aggregate with `python scripts/testing/rulegen_benchmark_case_sync.py merge` after edits.

cases.notes: Reading ほん should prefer book or volume over classifier and media-noise glosses.
Primary animal sense should outrank radical and spy side senses.
Learner-facing output should keep station and drop lodging or food side senses.
Everyday bare-lemma reading should prefer color over mood and erotic side senses.
Color reading should not surface political side senses in the learner-facing rule set.
Color reading should stay on blue rather than black, horse, or parser-noise glosses.
Color reading should prefer white over abstract innocence glosses.
Color reading should prefer black over guilt and stone side senses.
Temporal reading should prefer tomorrow over name noise.
Temporal reading should not emit person-name noise.
Sky reading should stay literal rather than drifting into metaphorical glosses.
Bare noun should prefer sea or ocean and drop participial noise.
Weather noun should prefer rain or rainfall over generic weather.
Common weather noun should not collapse into hair or vegetable noise.
Wind reading should not prioritize style or manner side senses.
Sound reading should not surface rumor or fame ahead of literal audio senses.
Voice reading should not drift into accent or feedback side senses.
Base verb should not borrow drink from neighboring senses.
Common verb should emit drink on the Kaikki-backed path.
Motion verb should prefer go and suppress come or cum noise.
Perception verb should keep literal senses and avoid nominal movie spillover.
Base commerce verb should prefer buy over appreciate or value.
Base commerce verb should emit sell, not betray or agitation side senses.
High-frequency verb should emit understand or know on the Kaikki-backed path.
Place reading should suppress adverb and particle-like noise.
